risk_notes: SQL scripts disable foreign key checks (PRAGMA foreign_keys = OFF) before bulk DELETE, which can lead to orphaned references in dependent tables (e.g., rental, payment) if the deleted customer_ids are referenced elsewhere.
Deduplication logic relies solely on first_name + last_name, which may incorrectly delete distinct customers who share the same name.
